Chinese technology giant Huawei has been found guilty of stealing trade secrets from American companies and deceiving banks about its business dealings in Iran. But in a significant development, a US jury acquitted the company of the most serious charge against it: racketeering conspiracy, which accused Huawei of operating like a criminal enterprise. Samah Qundeel explains the verdict, and what was Huawei accused of.
